title: SIU probing shooting in factory parking lot
article: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit is investigating a standoff at a northeast Toronto parking lot Tuesday afternoon that ended with a fatal shooting by Toronto police.
Officers from No. 41 Division arrived at A. G. Simpson Co. Ltd. on Progress Avenue around 3 p.m. Tuesday to find Peter Francis, 34, armed and pacing the factory's parking lot.
Witnesses said Mr. Francis shot Rayness Francis, believed to be his estranged wife, when she arrived for an afternoon shift at the Scarborough auto-parts maker.
Emergency task force officers surrounded the area. Mr. Francis was shot in the chest.
A post mortem on Mr. Francis was scheduled for yesterday.
A Toronto television news station showed footage Tuesday of Mr. Francis holding the gun under his chin before appearing to point it at the officers.
Ms. Francis, 47, was treated for gunshot wounds.
Crisis councilors were brought in yesterday to help employees at the plant deal with the shooting.
